content: The autonomous-task-brain skill follows a standardized 5-stage closed-loop task automation workflow: 1) Perceive (scan recent sessions to identify new, repeating, or failing tasks), 2) Retrieve (search local skills library, historical sessions, memory engine, Letta, and GitHub for optimal solutions), 3) Decide (select execute/suggest/skip action based on historical success rate, task complexity, and user preferences), 4) Execute (automatically create/modify skills, cron jobs, scripts or delegate subtasks), 5) Review (record execution results and update the knowledge base to optimize future task processing).
